tasks.description: Collaborated with a team to develop Nuve’s web platform using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, ensuring high performance and smooth deployments via Vercel.
Optimized frontend state management with Zustand, reducing unnecessary re-renders and enhancing user interactions.
Contributed to building an asynchronous FastAPI backend with Tortoise ORM and PostgreSQL, supporting scalable and efficient data operations.
Implemented integrations with AWS, Azure, and GCP APIs, helping automate cloud infrastructure and streamline server provisioning.
Enhanced analytics tracking by integrating Google Analytics & PostHog, supporting data-driven improvements for the platform.
Developed and deployed SAP Cloud Platform applications using JavaScript, SAPUI5, and OData, collaborating with backend teams on enterprise solutions.
Independently designed and built an internal time-tracking system with PTO tracking, approval workflows, and expense reimbursement, improving payroll accuracy and reducing manual admin tasks.
Optimized OData data transfers in SAP ECC, improving API response times and reducing system bottlenecks.
Built a T-Code lookup Fiori app using SAPUI5, JavaScript, OData, ABAP, and SAP Cloud Platform.
